text: Good morning - change of plans on my side: my partner is coming to Singapore for the summit dates after all, flying with me on the Frankfurt flight. The single at Bayview is a bit tight for two of us, so could we move to a double room or junior suite at the Harbourline instead? Same dates, 30 Sep through 3 Oct. We'll pay the room difference and my partner's flight ourselves - just tell us what the total is and we'll confirm. My interview is Thursday morning at 10:30, so whatever we pick still needs to get me to MBS comfortably in time.
